title: Encode Number
description: Convert a non-negative integer into a specific binary representation where the i-th number (1-indexed) corresponds to a binary string.
pseudocode:
1. num = num + 1
2. bin = num.toString(2)
3. result = bin.slice(1)

steps.note: Add 1 to the input to shift the mapping. 10 + 1 = 11.
Slice off the first bit '1' to get the encoded result: '011'.
